evidence_boundary.static_analysis: Exact-build instruction and dataflow analysis; Ghidra 12.1.4 isolated scratch outside repository.
evidence_boundary.runtime: Not run. No claim is CONFIRMED_BY_RUNTIME.
evidence_boundary.memory_writes: No game data writes, recovery invocation, executable disk patch, or teleport prototype. The observer installs temporary in-memory call wrappers only when explicitly enabled.

participant_identity.mechanism: Race/CarN/PlayerType is assigned from human participant count; AttractMode forces the count to zero. The supported one-human offline race classifies PlayerType 1 as human candidate and 2 as AI candidate.

addresses.role: read PlayerType and construct participant physics links

participant_identity.runtime_owner: PlayerType is logged per current physics handle; do not hardcode Car0.
participant_identity.lifetime_limit: Observer identity is the validated pointer tuple and local change generation; same-address allocator reuse with an identical tuple remains indistinguishable.

pointer_roles.physics_handle: handle; +0x14 controller, +0x0C four wheel records, +0x08 actor link
pointer_roles.camera: Separate camera ownership path; not the physics handle or body

addresses.role: physics handle creation/insertion and collision registration

manager_constructor.role: binds per-participant Car, Controller/Car, Progress, LastMarker, LimitState, ResetNo and other reset paths

update.role: reset manager update callback; vtable 0x00691508 slot +0x10

state_helpers.role: state 1 eligibility/duration helper; numeric meanings left unnamed
state 2 speed threshold and bounded accumulation helper
clears shared apply flag and restores selected backing values when timer active

update_flow.positive_timer: decrement timer, zero +0x44 entry, call 0x004CD1B0 which clears P+0x33; if decremented timer reaches zero, call 0x004CCC90(participant, mode=1)
update_flow.zero_timer_on_entry: clear reset state and call 0x004CCC90(participant, mode=0)
update_flow.semantic_limit: Numeric states, gates, additional flags, and backing constants are not relabeled as control semantics without consumer proof.

recovery.mode_one: choose RaceLine sample and publish transform

route_selector.role: uses participant position comparisons in route-sample selection

backing.flag: P+0x33 = 1 during mode-one publication; consumer does not clear it
backing.reset_no: increments on recovery; identified consumer resets camera tracking

consumer_chain.role: read flag and conditionally invoke transform application
copy published matrix and call reset helper
set chassis pose and perform bounded reset work
set body pose and previous position

per_car_update.role: controller transform consumer before five wheel record routines and later control/surface helper

substep_start.role: copies selected current body data into previous-step fields

substep_tail.role: final stage before decrement and second iteration

wheel_cleanup.details: zeroes wheel +0x120 dword in each four records; semantics unknown

controller_cleanup.details: mode 0 clears selected chassis/wheel/controller bytes; nonzero branch changes additional fields

surface_state.details: writes controller +0x78/+0x24/+0x28; meanings are not assigned

conditional_collision_path.details: may adjust chassis current position using a service; not a complete broadphase/contact reset proof

destination_and_recovery.reset_line_query: selected service boolean method returns false in this exact recovery path; does not validate arbitrary destination

startup_path.role: StartArea placement; optional Physics/Car0/Transform read is initialization evidence only

destination_and_recovery.race_state: separate output vectors and ResetNo are written; full arbitrary relocation synchronization is UNPROVEN

records: four wheel +0x04 bytes and +0x120 raw dwords
